sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition Nos.10709 And 10720 Of 2011
Common Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and Command Area Development for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in connected matters, this Court has allowed W.P.No.24294 of 2010, dated 23.11.2018 and the said order was confirmed by a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.287 of 2019 dated 22.01.2020 and requested to pass similar orders in both the writ petitions as well.
3.
Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondents has not disputed the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioners.

4. In view of the same, both the writ petition are allowed, directing the respondent No.1 to initiate land proceedings for acquisition of such of the lands of the petitioners, located ::2::
in Survey numbers mentioned by the Advocate Commissioner's in their reports dated 10.01.2017, which are submerged, under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ( for short, "the Act, 2013") forthwith and pay them market value compensation and all benefits under the said Act, 2013, within a period of four (04) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in these Writ Petitions shall stand closed.
